name: new-manager
summary: New (React) manager interface, backported to LLNG 2.23
description: Backport of the new LemonLDAP::NG 3.0 manager interface (configuration, sessions, notifications and second factors explorers, home page) to LLNG 2.23. Users switch between the historical interface and the new one; the historical interface stays the default.
author: Xavier Guimard / Linagora <https://linagora.com>
post_install: Append "newManager" to enabledModules in the [manager] section of lemonldap-ng.ini (never first: the first module is the default page), then reload the manager. The historical interface then has a "New manager (beta)" tab.
